stories.h: Dry Saturday, but coastal flood advisory for Puget Sound
stories.s: High tides bring a coastal flood advisory Saturday morning for inland Puget Sound and the San Juans, and a Mason County river flood warning runs to mid-morning. Rain and wind return Sunday night into Monday.

stories.h: Port confirms ICE gave notice before Sea-Tac jet bridge arrests
stories.s: The Port of Seattle now says federal officials gave limited advance notice before agents detained a father and daughter on an Alaska Airlines jet bridge. Commissioners want an independent investigation; Rep. Jayapal is pressing DHS for answers.

stories.h: Possible failed culvert closes SR 509 off-ramp in Seattle
stories.s: The southbound SR 509 exit to Myers Way and South Cloverdale Street is fully closed with no reopening estimate. Drivers heading to South Park or Highland Park should use earlier or later exits.

stories.h: Food court fight sparks false shooting scare at Alderwood Mall
stories.s: Black Friday shoppers fled the Lynnwood mall after a fight that knocked over chairs and tables sounded like gunfire. Police found no shooting and no injuries; some stores locked down on their own.

stories.h: Douglas County solar plan would be state's largest
stories.s: A Utah company has applied to state regulators for a 200-megawatt solar farm with battery storage on about 2,900 acres near Trinidad, projected to generate $113 million in taxes over 40 years.

stories.h: National Nordic Museum workers end three-day strike
stories.s: Union staff at the Ballard museum returned Friday after striking over the firing of an exhibit designer they say was retaliation for organizing. He hasn't been rehired; bargaining resumes Dec. 11.

talking.h: Darnold starts, Purdy out for Seahawks-49ers showdown
talking.s: Sam Darnold, Charles Cross and Leonard Williams return Sunday, while Quenton Nelson, Abraham Lucas and Jarran Reed are out. San Francisco ruled out Brock Purdy with a sprained ankle, so Mac Jones starts.

talking.h: Gonzaga blows second-half lead, falls to Creighton in OT
talking.s: The No. 22 Zags lost 97-89 in Las Vegas after going 18 of 30 at the line, handing Creighton its first win over Gonzaga since 1977 and a Players Era 16 title-game berth.

talking.h: Kakko's late goals lift Kraken past McDavid's Oilers
talking.s: Kaapo Kakko scored twice in the third period of a 4-2 comeback win that moved Seattle to 12-10-1, though goalie Philipp Grubauer left hurt. The teams meet again Saturday in Seattle.

coming.s: Washington (7-4) can dent Oregon's playoff hopes at Autzen Stadium Saturday, 4:30 p.m. PT on NBC; the Ducks are favored by about two touchdowns.

coming.h: WSU closes season vs. San Diego State
coming.s: The 2-9 Cougars honor 12 seniors before a 3:30 p.m. kickoff in Pullman on The CW; WSU won't play in a bowl this year.

coming.h: Seahawks at 49ers, Mac Jones starting for SF
coming.s: Seattle visits the NFC West-leading 49ers Sunday with Darnold back; Purdy is out with an ankle sprain.

coming.h: WSDOT reassesses closed North Cascades Highway
coming.s: Crews check the 37-mile SR 20 closure over Rainy and Washington passes Monday; WSDOT hasn't decided whether it becomes the season-long winter closure.
The Zags return home to McCarthey Athletic Center Tuesday against the NAIA Mountaineers after their overtime loss in Las Vegas.
Pierce County hand-recounts the House race in which Democrat Jenn Marie Strickling leads Republican Rep. Cyndy Jacobsen by 80 votes.
